pages.text: The energy cell stores 1,000,000 FE and moves 1,000 FE/t. It takes energy on every side but the front and gives it through the front, which faces the player when placed.
The energy bank stores 10,000,000 FE and moves 10,000 FE/t. It works like the cell.
The bars on the front show the charge; the lamp is red, yellow or green. A broken block keeps its charge in the item.
pages.title: Charge
